name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon

text.formatted: Starting at 13th level, you learn to touch the ki of other minds so that you understand all spoken languages. Moreover, any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.
text.plain: Starting at 13th level, you learn to touch the ki of other minds so that you understand all spoken languages. Moreover, any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.

gaps.name: Understand all spoken languages without gaining literacy or language proficiency.
A creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.
